title: Compute, hosting and moving data
summary: Where an application can run in Azure, and the tools for moving files and servers into it.

vmss.clue: A group of identical virtual machines that scales out and in automatically

availability-set.clue: Spreads virtual machines across fault and update domains, so not all go down at once

avd.clue: Windows desktops and apps that run in Azure and are used from anywhere

app-service.clue: Hosts web apps and APIs without you managing the servers underneath

functions.clue: Runs small pieces of code in response to events, such as an HTTP request or a timer

aci.clue: Runs a container on demand, without managing virtual machines

azcopy.clue: A command-line tool that copies blobs and files to or from a storage account

storage-explorer.clue: A desktop app for browsing and managing the data in storage accounts

file-sync.clue: Keeps Azure Files and Windows file servers in sync, with a cache kept on-premises

migrate.clue: Discovers, assesses and moves on-premises servers, databases and apps to Azure

data-box.clue: A physical device shipped to you, for moving large amounts of data offline
